description: This file defines the class `LinearAPoT`, a specialized quantized linear layer implementing APoT quantization for use within the PyTorch framework. It includes methods for initializing with weight data, decomposing APoT binary representations, performing bit-shift multiplications, and matrix multiplication tailored to APoT quantization.

classes.name: LinearAPoT
classes.description: A quantized linear module that employs APoT quantization, supporting operations like decomposing APoT binary representations, performing bit-shift based multiplications, and matrix multiplications suited for floating-point results.

methods.name: __init__(self, weight2quantize: torch.Tensor, b: int, k: int)
methods.description: Initializes the LinearAPoT layer with weight tensor, bias, and quantization parameter k, computing qparams via an observer and quantizing the weight.

methods.name: decompose_APoT(self, x)
methods.description: Decomposes a binary APoT representation into a list of k-sized binary blocks.

methods.name: bitshift_mul(self, weight_val, r)
methods.description: Performs multiplication of an APoT weight block (represented as binary digits) with a scalar r using bit-shifting.

methods.name: matmul(self, decomposed_weight, activation)
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication between decomposed APoT weights and activations using bit-shifted multiplication.

methods.name: torch.FloatTensor forward(self, activation: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Performs the forward pass, applying APoT-based multiplication between weights and activation tensors to produce an output tensor.

methods.name: from_reference( cls, ref_qlinear, alpha: torch.Tensor, gamma: torch.Tensor, quantization_levels: torch.Tensor, level_indices: torch.Tensor, )
